description.de: Plant und führt npm-Updates aus: Patch/Minor gebündelt, Major-Gruppen einzeln, jeweils gegen die Prüf-Scripts des Projekts; was rot wird, wird zurückgenommen. Ergebnis ist ein Branch im isolierten Run-Workspace, KI nur für Migrationshinweise zu gescheiterten Major-Updates.
description.en: Plans and applies npm updates: patch/minor bundled, major groups one by one, each checked against the project's check scripts; anything that turns red is rolled back. The result is a branch in the isolated run workspace; AI is only used for migration notes on failed major updates.

author: MySuricates
instructions:
Plan and update a project's npm dependencies – deterministically via shell, AI only for failed major updates.

Flow: isolated run workspace with its own branch → npm ci + baseline gates → npm outdated is split into patch/minor and major groups (groups: @types/x with x, same scope, required peers) → approval → patch/minor bundled (halved on red until the culprit packages are known) → each major group on its own → per failed major group a TODO proposal with a migration note (AI), per red patch/minor package one with an error excerpt (no AI) → report.

A red gate runs a second time before it counts; the report names such unstable gates.

Variables: frontend_dir (directory with package.json relative to the project, default "."), gate_scripts (npm scripts used as checks; only existing ones run, at least one must exist), exclude_packages (packages that are never touched, separated by commas or spaces).

Modes via the approval step: interactive (default) asks about the plan. For an unattended run (schedule), set the variable approval_mode to "auto" and approval_answer to "Run everything", "Patch/minor only" or "Plan only" (default) – in the schedule context, without changing the workflow.

Result: commits on the run branch in the run workspace; pushing is blocked there. The report gives the git fetch command to take them over. Gate GREEN = everything up to date, YELLOW = updates pending. If the Playwright version changes, the report points out the required browser download – nothing is downloaded. TODO proposals (autoTodo, mode approval) are confirmed by a person; a later green run closes them.

Requirements: npm with package-lock.json (pnpm/yarn are rejected), git, node, python3. The baseline must be green, otherwise the run aborts – a failure could otherwise not be attributed to any update.

config.label: Workspace, npm ci, baseline gates
config.command:
set -euo pipefail
set -- {{ execution_path }}; WS="${1:-}"
set -- {{ workspace_source_sha }}; SRC="${1:-}"
set -- {{ frontend_dir }}; FE_REL="${1:-.}"
set -- {{ gate_scripts }}; GATES="$*"

fail() {
  echo "ERROR: $1"
  echo "gate_status: RED"
  echo "gate_category: dependencies"
  echo "gate_description: $1"
  exit 1
}

# Work only in the isolated run workspace: the original checkout stays untouched.
if [ "$WS" = "{{" ] || [ "$SRC" = "{{" ] || [ ! -d "$WS/.git" ]; then
  fail "No isolated run workspace - the first block needs workspace.mode=isolated"
fi
[ "$FE_REL" = "{{" ] && FE_REL="."
case "$GATES" in *"{{"*|"") GATES="typecheck lint test build" ;; esac
case "$FE_REL" in
  /*|..|../*|*/..|*/../*) fail "frontend_dir must be a relative path inside the project: $FE_REL" ;;
esac

FE="$WS/$FE_REL"
[ -f "$FE/package.json" ] || fail "No package.json under '$FE_REL'"
if [ ! -f "$FE/package-lock.json" ]; then
  for f in pnpm-lock.yaml yarn.lock bun.lock bun.lockb; do
    [ -f "$FE/$f" ] && fail "$f found - this workflow supports only npm (package-lock.json)"
  done
  fail "No package-lock.json under '$FE_REL'"
fi

# Intermediate state lives under .git/ - so it never ends up in a commit.
ST="$WS/.git/dep-update"
rm -rf "$ST"
mkdir -p "$ST/logs"
(cd "$FE" && pwd) > "$ST/fe_abs"
printf '%s\n' "$FE_REL" > "$ST/fe_rel"

# Gates = the requested npm scripts that actually exist in package.json.
node -e '
  const s = require(process.argv[1]).scripts || {};
  for (const g of process.argv[2].split(/[\s,]+/)) if (g && s[g]) console.log(g);
' "$FE/package.json" "$GATES" > "$ST/gates"
[ -s "$ST/gates" ] || fail "None of the gate scripts ($GATES) is in package.json - nothing is updated without a check"

cat > "$ST/lib.sh" <<'LIB'
# Shared functions of the update blocks. Expects $ST.
FE="$(cat "$ST/fe_abs")"

# Run one gate; the output also goes to $ST/gate.out
gate_once() {
  (cd "$FE" && CI=true npm run --silent "$1") > "$ST/gate.out" 2>&1
  local rc=$?
  cat "$ST/gate.out" >> "$2"
  return $rc
}

# All gates one after another; appends to log $1. A red gate runs a second
# time - only then does it count (unstable tests under load). Reason -> $ST/reason
run_gates() {
  local g
  while IFS= read -r g; do
    [ -n "$g" ] || continue
    echo "--- npm run $g" >> "$1"
    gate_once "$g" "$1" && continue
    echo "--- npm run $g (retry)" >> "$1"
    if gate_once "$g" "$1"; then
      echo "$g" >> "$ST/flaky.txt"
      continue
    fi
    echo "Gate '$g' red: $(error_lines "$ST/gate.out")" > "$ST/reason"
    return 1
  done < "$ST/gates"
}

# The first real error lines (not warnings) of a gate output, on one line
error_lines() {
  { grep -E -m 3 "[[:space:]]error[[:space:]]|error TS[0-9]|FAIL|ERR!" "$1" \
      || grep -E -v "warning" "$1" | grep -E -m 3 "[Ee]rror|✖|×" \
      || tail -n 3 "$1"; } | cut -c1-140 | tr -s ' \n' ' '
}

# Short name for file names
slug() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr '/@' '__'; }

# try_update <log> <name@version>... : update package.json, install, run the gates
try_update() {
  local log="$1"; shift
  : > "$log"
  if ! python3 "$ST/apply.py" "$ST" "$@" >> "$log" 2>&1; then
    echo "package.json could not be updated" > "$ST/reason"; return 1
  fi
  if ! (cd "$FE" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund) >> "$log" 2>&1; then
    echo "npm install failed (peer conflict?)" > "$ST/reason"; return 1
  fi
  run_gates "$log"
}

# bisect_update <name@version>... : try the whole set; red -> split it in half.
# Green subsets are committed, red single packages end up in skipped_minor.txt.
bisect_update() {
  local log="$ST/logs/minor-$(slug "$1")-$#.log"
  if try_update "$log" "$@"; then
    if [ $# -eq 1 ]; then
      commit_update "deps(npm): $1"
    else
      commit_update "deps(npm): $# patch/minor updates" "$(printf '%s\n' "$@")"
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$@" >> "$ST/applied.txt"
    echo "  green $# package(s): $*"
    return 0
  fi
  revert_update
  if [ $# -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "$1 - $(cat "$ST/reason") (Log: logs/$(basename "$log"))" >> "$ST/skipped_minor.txt"
    echo "  red   $1 - $(cat "$ST/reason")"
    return 0
  fi
  local half=$(( $# / 2 ))
  echo "  red   $# packages ($(head -n 1 "$ST/reason")) - splitting in half"
  bisect_update "${@:1:half}"
  bisect_update "${@:half+1}"
}

revert_update() {
  (cd "$FE" && git checkout -q -- package.json package-lock.json && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund) > "$ST/revert.log" 2>&1
}

# commit_update <title> [<text>]
commit_update() {
  (cd "$FE" && git add -- package.json package-lock.json && \
    if [ -n "${2:-}" ]; then git commit -q -m "$1" -m "$2"; else git commit -q -m "$1"; fi)
}
LIB

cat > "$ST/apply.py" <<'PY'
# apply.py <state-dir> <name@version>... - sets the versions in package.json,
# keeps the section, the prefix (^, ~ or exact) and the indentation.
import json, re, sys

st = sys.argv[1]
fe = open(st + "/fe_abs").read().strip()
path = fe + "/package.json"
raw = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
pkg = json.loads(raw)
m = re.search(r'^([ \t]+)"', raw, re.M)
indent = m.group(1) if m else "  "

for item in sys.argv[2:]:
    name, _, to = item.rpartition("@")
    for sec in ("dependencies", "devDependencies", "optionalDependencies"):
        deps = pkg.get(sec) or {}
        if name in deps:
            prefix = re.match(r"[\^~]?", deps[name]).group(0)
            deps[name] = prefix + to
            print(f"{sec}: {name} -> {deps[name]}")
            break
    else:
        sys.exit(f"{name} is not in package.json")

with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(json.dumps(pkg, indent=indent, ensure_ascii=False) + ("\n" if raw.endswith("\n") else ""))
PY

. "$ST/lib.sh"
echo "Project: $FE_REL (source ${SRC:0:12}, branch $(git -C "$WS" branch --show-current))"
echo "Gates: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$ST/gates")"

(cd "$FE" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund) > "$ST/npm-ci.log" 2>&1 || {
  tail -n 40 "$ST/npm-ci.log"
  fail "npm ci failed"
}
if run_gates "$ST/baseline.log"; then
  echo "Baseline: all gates green."
else
  tail -n 60 "$ST/baseline.log"
  fail "Baseline red ($(cat "$ST/reason")) - fix the existing failure first, otherwise no failure can be attributed to an update"
fi

config.label: Plan: classify and group outdated packages
Approval
config.question:
{{ block.plan.output }}

---

**How to proceed?**

- **Run everything**: patch/minor bundled, then each major group on its own – anything that turns red is rolled back
- **Patch/minor only**: major updates stay open
- **Plan only**: change nothing

config.label: Update patch/minor
config.command:
set -euo pipefail
set -- {{ execution_path }}; WS="${1:-}"
set -- {{ update_freigabe }}; ANTWORT="$*"

ST="$WS/.git/dep-update"
. "$ST/lib.sh"
: > "$ST/major_items.txt"
: > "$ST/applied.txt"
: > "$ST/skipped_minor.txt"
printf '%s\n' "$ANTWORT" > "$ST/antwort"

case "$ANTWORT" in
  "Run everything") cp "$ST/major_keys.txt" "$ST/major_items.txt" ;;
  "Patch/minor only") ;;
  *) echo "Approval: '$ANTWORT' - nothing is changed."; exit 0 ;;
esac

python3 -c '
import json, sys
for m in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["minor"]:
    print(m["name"] + "@" + m["to"])
' "$ST/plan.json" > "$ST/minor_items.txt"
if [ ! -s "$ST/minor_items.txt" ]; then
  echo "No patch/minor updates."
  exit 0
fi

set --
while IFS= read -r i; do set -- "$@" "$i"; done < "$ST/minor_items.txt"

echo "Patch/minor: $# packages - all together first, split in half on red:"
bisect_update "$@"

config.label: Major groups one by one
config.command:
set -euo pipefail
set -- {{ execution_path }}; WS="${1:-}"
set -- {{ gruppe }}; KEY="${1:-}"

ST="$WS/.git/dep-update"
. "$ST/lib.sh"

set --
while IFS= read -r i; do set -- "$@" "$i"; done < <(python3 -c '
import json, sys
for m in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["groups"][sys.argv[2]]:
    print(m["name"] + "@" + m["to"])
' "$ST/plan.json" "$KEY")

LOG="$ST/logs/major-$KEY.log"
if try_update "$LOG" "$@"; then
  commit_update "deps(npm): major $*" "Group $KEY, gates green."
  echo "$KEY" >> "$ST/applied_major.txt"
  echo "green  $KEY: $*"
  exit 0
fi

# Red: keep the material for the migration note, then roll back.
D="$ST/failed/$KEY"
mkdir -p "$D"
printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$D/pakete.txt"
cp "$ST/reason" "$D/grund.txt"
tail -n 150 "$LOG" > "$D/gate.log"
for i in "$@"; do
  n="${i%@*}"
  for c in CHANGELOG.md CHANGELOG.MD changelog.md CHANGELOG History.md; do
    if [ -f "$FE/node_modules/$n/$c" ]; then
      head -c 15000 "$FE/node_modules/$n/$c" > "$D/changelog-${n//\//__}.md"
      break
    fi
  done
  (cd "$FE" && npm view "$i" repository.url homepage) >> "$D/quellen.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
done
revert_update
echo "$KEY" >> "$ST/failed.txt"
echo "red    $KEY: $(cat "$ST/reason") - rolled back"
exit 1

config.label: Migration notes for red major groups
config.command:
An npm major update failed the project's checks and was rolled back.
Package group: {{ gruppe }}

Material (read only) in the directory {{ execution_path }}/.git/dep-update/failed/{{ gruppe }}/ :
- pakete.txt: package@target version
- grund.txt: which check failed
- gate.log: output of npm install or of the check
- changelog-*.md: start of the changelog, if the package ships one
- quellen.txt: repository and homepage
You may read the project's source files to name the affected places.

Rules: do NOT write any files, do NOT run any commands, do not install anything.

Answer with exactly one line in this format and nothing else:
todo_item: Migrate npm major update <package group> to <target version> | MEDIUM | dependencies,npm | <cause in one sentence>. Steps: <two to four concrete steps with file names>. Material: .git/dep-update/failed/<package group>/ in the run workspace.

No vertical bar inside the fields, no line break.

config.label: Report and gate
config.command:
set -euo pipefail
set -- {{ execution_path }}; WS="${1:-}"
set -- {{ workspace_source_sha }}; SRC="${1:-}"

ST="$WS/.git/dep-update"
cnt() { if [ -f "$1" ]; then awk 'NF { n++ } END { print n + 0 }' "$1"; else echo 0; fi; }
lst() { if [ -s "$1" ]; then sed 's/^/- /' "$1"; else echo "- (none)"; fi; }

ANTWORT="$(cat "$ST/antwort" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
FE_REL="$(cat "$ST/fe_rel")"
BRANCH="$(git -C "$WS" branch --show-current)"
MINOR_TOTAL="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(len(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["minor"]))' "$ST/plan.json")"
MAJOR_TOTAL="$(cnt "$ST/major_keys.txt")"
MINOR_OK="$(cnt "$ST/applied.txt")"
MINOR_RED="$(cnt "$ST/skipped_minor.txt")"
MAJOR_OK="$(cnt "$ST/applied_major.txt")"
MAJOR_RED="$(cnt "$ST/failed.txt")"
COMMITS="$(git -C "$WS" rev-list --count "$SRC..HEAD")"
OFFEN=$(( MINOR_TOTAL - MINOR_OK + MAJOR_TOTAL - MAJOR_OK ))

echo "## npm update: result for $FE_REL"
echo
echo "Approval: **$ANTWORT**"
echo
echo "| | planned | applied | red |"
echo "|---|---|---|---|"
echo "| Patch/minor packages | $MINOR_TOTAL | $MINOR_OK | $MINOR_RED |"
echo "| Major groups | $MAJOR_TOTAL | $MAJOR_OK | $MAJOR_RED |"
echo
echo "### Commits ($COMMITS)"
git -C "$WS" log --oneline "$SRC..HEAD" | sed 's/^/- /'
[ "$COMMITS" -gt 0 ] || echo "- (none)"
echo
echo "### Red and rolled back"
echo "Patch/Minor:"
lst "$ST/skipped_minor.txt"
echo "Major (material per group under .git/dep-update/failed/ in the run workspace):"
lst "$ST/failed.txt"
if [ -s "$ST/flaky.txt" ]; then
  echo
  echo "### Unstable gates"
  echo "Green only on the second attempt (tests under load?) - the updates were applied anyway:"
  sort "$ST/flaky.txt" | uniq -c | awk '{ print "- " $2 ": " $1 "x" }'
fi
echo
echo "Logs per attempt: .git/dep-update/logs/ in the run workspace."
echo
if [ "$COMMITS" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "### Take over the commits"
  echo "The commits are on \`$BRANCH\` in the run workspace; pushing is blocked there. In your own checkout:"
  echo
  echo "    git fetch $WS $BRANCH:deps/npm-update-$(date +%Y%m%d)"
  echo "    git log --oneline ..deps/npm-update-$(date +%Y%m%d)"
  echo
fi

# Playwright version changed? The new version expects its own browser download - without it
# tests and screenshots abort with "Executable doesn't exist". Only a hint: the run downloads
# nothing, the download is a deliberate decision.
PW_CHANGE="$(python3 - "$WS" "$SRC" "$FE_REL" <<'PY' || true
import json, subprocess, sys
ws, src, fe = sys.argv[1:4]
fe = fe[2:] if fe.startswith("./") else fe
path = ("" if fe in (".", "") else fe.rstrip("/") + "/") + "package-lock.json"

def playwright(rev):
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", ws, "show", rev + ":" + path],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
        pkgs = json.loads(out).get("packages") or {}
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
        return None
    for name in ("node_modules/playwright-core", "node_modules/playwright", "node_modules/@playwright/test"):
        v = (pkgs.get(name) or {}).get("version")
        if v:
            return v
    return None

old, new = playwright(src), playwright("HEAD")
if old and new and old != new:
    print(old + " -> " + new)
PY
)"
if [ -n "$PW_CHANGE" ]; then
  echo "### Note: Playwright version changed ($PW_CHANGE)"
  echo "The new version needs its own browser. After taking over the commits, run \`npx playwright install chromium\` in the frontend (or the project script for it, such as \`npm run pw:install\`) - otherwise Playwright tests and screenshots abort with \"Executable doesn't exist\". The run downloads nothing automatically."
  echo
fi

TODOS=""
# Red patch/minor packages: TODO proposal without AI, the reason is already in the log.
if [ -s "$ST/skipped_minor.txt" ]; then
  TODOS="$TODOS${TODOS:+
}$(sed -E 's/\|/\//g; s/^([^ ]+)@([^ ]+) - (.*)$/todo_item: npm update \1 to \2 blocked | LOW | dependencies,npm | \3 Check .git\/dep-update\/ in the run workspace, adapt the code, then run again./' "$ST/skipped_minor.txt")"
fi
if [ -n "$TODOS" ]; then
  echo "### TODO proposals (red patch/minor packages)"
  printf '%s\n' "$TODOS"
  echo
fi

echo "gate_category: dependencies"
if [ "$OFFEN" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "gate_status: GREEN"
  echo "gate_description: All npm dependencies up to date ($COMMITS commits)"
else
  echo "gate_status: YELLOW"
  echo "gate_description: $OFFEN npm updates pending ($MINOR_RED patch/minor red, $MAJOR_RED major groups red, approval: $ANTWORT)"
fi
